summary.result: The analysis resluts showed that the maximum deflection at the apex of arch was occurred when 70% of arch span was loaded.
summary.background: For this purpose, the vertical and the radial load conditions were considered as a distributed loading and the loading range is varied from 40% to 100% of arch span.
summary.method: It is known that the optimal rise to span ratio between 0.2 and 0.3 when the vertical or radial distributed load is applied.
